:::{#exr-matrix-map-linear-practice}
#### Recognizing a linear map as multiplication by a matrix

@thm-matrix-map-linear saves checking additivity and homogeneity by hand:
a [function](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/functions.html#def-function) that multiplies its input by a fixed [matrix](#def-matrix) is a [linear map](#def-linear-map).
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals^2$ be

$$
f(\vx) = (x_1 + 2 x_2,\ 3 x_1 - x_2).
$$

Is $f$ a [linear map](#def-linear-map)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Find a $2 \times 2$ [matrix](#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$ with $f(\vx) = \matr{A}\vx$,
using @def-matvec-mult.

:::
